name: Birthday Countdown
tagline: An App counting down to your next birthday!
blurb: Birthday Countdown is a Free and Open Source App for Android Phones counting down to your next birthday.
description:
Birthday Countdown is a Free and Open Source App for Android Phones counting down to your next birthday.

Can't await your next birthday? Me neither! So I built this Countdown App for you ^^
~ Kim <33

Features
• Customizable birth date

• Countdown to next birthday

• Milestones on the way to next birthday
